patch.value: Resume bounded Beads transfers with dependency closure and chunk receipts

Add a dependency-aware transfer plan and resumable per-chunk application using public pm SDK capabilities. Overlap checked against the current CLI, pm-beads and pm-context: keep existing JSONL parser, structural validation and core transactions; do not duplicate neighborhood packing.

A killed transfer resumes without duplicates; A late cross-chunk dependency is resolved without dangling edges; Exceeding closure limits yields an explicit omission or refusal receipt; Concurrent drainers inspect and mutate state under the SDK writer lease; foreign records are skipped with reasons; all transition boundaries have interleaving tests on one non-git tracker; Typed SDK and CLI, bounded TOON/JSON receipts, README and example, public tracker copy measurements, and npm plus Bun CI release gates

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap audit: registry confirms CLI 2026.10.24; this package retains its 2026.10.20 SDK pin. Existing Beads validation handles structural errors, cycles and aliases; existing import batches delegate core mutations. Core SDK exports commitItemMutations and commitWorkspaceTransaction with resumable journals; pm-context provides bounded neighborhood/delta packs, not a transfer ledger. Add only closure planning, immutable transfer identities and per-chunk receipts around those public coordinators. Use non-git trackers and deterministic interleaving at every package/coordinator transition.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Design refinement: dependency-first creation includes parent closure, so every published edge targets an earlier owned row even when its source record appears later or crosses chunks. The SDK transaction journal itself is the per-chunk checkpoint; no second mutable checkpoint store. Ownership comes from immutable create history, not copied bead_id markers. Skip foreign identities and their unavailable dependents, preserve peer edits, and never delete or close progress during compensation. The pinned bulk-create helper adopts any occupied id, so ownership-aware steps use commitWorkspaceTransaction plus PmClient.create instead.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Operational boundary: this is creation-only exchange, not merging existing identities. Use reconciliation for incoming updates. Exact plans and SDK journals must be retained to resume; changed payloads or bounds create separate exchanges. A killed process may leave the core 30-second lease until expiry; busy is a typed retry receipt. Public SDK pin stays unchanged. Linked-test results are reported but tracker test-result persistence is disabled by existing project policy; results are recorded here. Full npm and Bun release gates are delegated to CI to avoid saturating the host.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final ownership audit found a lifecycle interleaving worth testing: a peer can delete and recreate the same core id while history remains append-only. Ownership now uses the most recent create operation rather than the first, so a foreign replacement cannot inherit an earlier transfer creation marker. Added the same-tracker regression; foreign replacements and dependents skip without modifying the replacement.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Lifecycle experiment clarification: the public core correctly refuses recreating an identity with retained history (item_identity_reserved). No history was rewritten. The added regression instead uses an actual foreign create/delete tombstone: transfer now reads retained history even when its document is absent and skips that reserved identity and its dependent with reasons. This prevents a generic reserved-id failure and preserves peer deletion. Ownership also checks the latest creation record for defensive compatibility; source inspection failures classify the occupied identity as foreign.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: SDK audit: PmClient.create dispatches runCreate, whose inheritFocusedParent reads saved tracker focus whenever parent is absent and unset lacks parent. The typed SharedLinkedResourceClearOptions.unset supports explicit clearing; CreateResult documents parent_source=focus but the create typings do not explain unset parent as the focus opt-out. Templates apply only when template is supplied (omission disables); no standalone default-tags/default-assignee settings exist in this pin. Configured template fields, governance create_default_type/create_mode_default, per-type default_status, hardcoded priority fallback and author fallback are covered by source-explicit values. Update/link/close/restore do not inherit create defaults and must retain unrelated local fields; their author is now explicit. Transfer ownership accepts the SDK audit suffix appended by explicit unsets.
